Definition: from G4655; opaque, i.e. (figuratively) benighted:--dark, full of darkness.
BiblicalUsage: Skoteinos means dark, full of darkness, and it is the word for a body whose eye has gone bad. When the eye is single the whole body is full of light, but when the eye is evil the whole body is full of darkness, and if the light in us be darkness, how great is that darkness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the eye is the lamp of the body, and a dark eye darkens everything it looks at.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
